consequence.statement: Invocations of `flux events` that pass `--all-namespaces` will now see the flag honored (events reported across all namespaces) instead of the previous buggy behavior where the flag was not respected.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is required; optionally verify that `flux events --all-namespaces` now returns events from all namespaces as the flag indicates.

assertion.statement: The `flux events` command in flux 2.7.0 now respects the `--all-namespaces` flag, which it previously did not.
